purpose: Document first-party local cadastral evidence and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access review.
assessment: Urgench has first-party regional cadastral administration evidence: the Chamber of State Cadastres directory lists the Xorazm regional department in Urganch city. Official national descriptions identify cadastral maintenance, geodesy/cartography, and real-estate-rights registration as agency functions. Public geoportal/service entry points were identified, but no safe anonymous parcel feature response containing a native parcel ID and full geometry was verified. No sample GeoJSON is retained.
registryBasis: Local/regional custodian evidenced by the official directory entry for Xorazm viloyati boshqarmasi at Urganch shahar, Istiqlol ko‘chasi 14-uy. National agency prose is recorded separately and is not used alone as local evidence.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Chamber of State Cadastres directory lists Xorazm regional department in Urganch city and separately lists the Urganch district office. The regional entry is the local custodian evidence used here.

Official Cadastre Agency page describes state cadastral maintenance, geodesy/cartography, land/cadastral control, and real-estate services through State Service Centers and the Unified Interactive State Services Portal.
Officially branded National geo-information portal with coordinate and cadastral-number search UI and Esri-powered map shell; no safe anonymous parcel feature response was retrieved.
State Urban Planning Cadastre geoportal entry point; search result describes public urban-cadastre information, but the reviewed route did not provide a verified anonymous parcel geometry schema.

Official Chamber public-service portal in test mode lists nearby cadastral-number determination, state real-estate registry, and other workflows; these are service/property workflows, not a verified citywide anonymous parcel-vector feed.

attempts.result: SUCCESS: Xorazm regional Chamber of State Cadastres entry located in Urganch city; no parcel geometry endpoint or schema exposed in the reviewed directory.
HTTP/content available through first-party page review; agency scope and public-service channels documented, but no parcel geometry response.

attempts.method: anonymous HTTPS GET and public geoportal inspection
attempts.result: The public search index exposed the map shell and coordinate/cadastral-number controls. Direct curl retrieval timed out after 20 seconds, so no JavaScript/configuration or feature request was safely verified. Timeout is not treated as parcel absence.
Search index described the State Urban Planning Cadastre geoportal. Direct curl returned HTTP 403 from nginx; no retry, bypass, login, or protected request attempted. No geometry retained.

Public page states the platform is in test mode and lists cadastral-number determination and registry workflows. No parcel polygon response was requested; no personal or property identifiers submitted.

queryOutcomes.english: First-party Cadastre Agency, Chamber of State Cadastres, National Geoportal, and State Urban Planning Cadastre sources found; safe anonymous parcel geometry+ID contract not verified.
queryOutcomes.local: Uzbek Latin-language first-party search identified the same official cadastral institutions and Urganch/Xorazm regional office; no safe anonymous parcel geometry+ID contract verified.

safeFieldAllowlist: native parcel/object ID only if directly returned by a public source
full polygon geometry only if directly returned by a public source
geometryDisposition: No full geometry sample retained: no safe anonymous native-ID-plus-polygon response was verified.

runtimeAssessment.reason: Serial runtime qualification is held because no anonymous parcel feature schema and geometry response were verified.
